_note: English. `html` traduz o index.html (chave = data-i18n); `js` são as strings que o JS monta; `works` sobrescreve o blurb de works.json e dá a tradução do título ao lado — o título em si NÃO se traduz: está impresso no pôster.

html.meta.title: Onde Moram as Palavras — your story, written in thousands of words
html.meta.description: Custom typographic art: your photo or your song turned into an image made of thousands of words. Launch edition, ordered over WhatsApp.
html.meta.ogDescription: Your story, written in thousands of words until it forms an image.
html.hero.lead: Your photo, your song, your story — written thousands of times until they form an image.
html.manifesto.title: An image made of thousands of words.
html.manifesto.body: Every piece starts from something that already exists — a song, a letter, a memory. We turn it into thousands of words that arrange themselves, letter by letter, until they form a face, a scene, a memory you can finally see.
html.collection.title: Nine specimens
html.collection.lead: Every piece catalogued like a lab specimen: typeface, type size, engine layers, real print dimensions.
html.how.title: From photo to artwork
html.compare.beforeAlt: Original reference photo used in the artwork Ouro Marrom
html.compare.rangeAria: Drag to compare the original photo with the typographic artwork
html.steps.1.title: Tell your story on WhatsApp
html.steps.1.body: Send the image you want to transform and the words that will build the piece.
html.steps.2.title: We turn it into art
html.steps.2.body: We put the typographic engine together with human sensibility to create a one-of-a-kind image.
html.steps.3.title: Get it by email
html.steps.3.body: A high-resolution file, ready to keep, to print or to give away.
html.pricing.intro: Every great story begins with the first people who believe in it. So for the launch of the brand we are opening a special edition of only 5 first creations — a chance to turn your story into a work of art built where artificial intelligence, design and human sensibility meet.
html.pricing.launchList:
• Custom creation in high quality
  • Art built out of your own words
  • High-resolution digital file
  • Ready to print
html.pricing.regularList:
• Exclusive creation
  • Personalised artistic process
  • High-resolution digital file
  • Professional print quality
html.pricing.why: Why is there a launch price? Because every creation needs a first story. These five first pieces will be part of the birth of Onde Moram as Palavras — the first memories turned into art, the first meetings between people, words and technology.
html.brief.title: What will become art?
html.brief.lead: No cart, no checkout. You pick the options, we assemble the message, and you send it from your own WhatsApp — nothing else leaves this browser.
html.brief.legend1: 1 · The image you want to transform
html.brief.legend2: 2 · The words that will build the piece
html.brief.name: Full name
html.brief.note: When you send, WhatsApp opens with this message ready — you confirm and send it from there.
html.footer.tagline: Typographic art lab · orders over WhatsApp
html.footer.fine: TYPOGRAPHIC EXPERIMENT — EVERY PIECE IS UNIQUE, BUILT OUT OF YOUR OWN WORDS

ouro-marrom.blurb: The hat turns into solid mass and the skin is the highlight, in gold.

nossa-senhora.blurb: The whole prayer fits inside the veil. Flat background, clean cut-out.

cidade-de-deus.blurb: The lettering of the poster becomes letters made of letters.

dom-casmurro.blurb: A collodion plate: the dark vignette became a natural frame.

garota-de-ipanema.blurb: Figure cut out, the Dois Irmãos peaks in thin outline behind.

central-do-brasil.blurb: Handwriting: the film is about letters written by hand.

ainda-estou-aqui.blurb: Typewriting — the film is made of letterhead paper.

emicida.blurb: No mask: tonal contrast alone separates suit, collar and background.

debret-antropofagia.blurb: TUPI in 23 cm type wrapping the colonial engraving.
